Create an EDI Text Object

Source: R/edi_text.R
edi_text.Rd

Create an EDI Text Object

Usage

edi_text(x, ...)

Arguments

x

raw X12 text input

...

dots

Value

an <hcc::TextEDI> S7 object

Details

Methods for edi_index:

  • ANY

  • character

  • hcc::TextEDI

  • list

Examples

edi_text(x12_EX$`820`$`218`)
